reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: 1909 United Presbyterian Board of Publication: public domain needs a death year before 1955 (or "traditional": true for an anonymous source). Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1839, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. The Open Hymnal's own source: "The Lutheran Hymnary", 1913 Hymn 578 Lyrics source: "The Psalter with Responsive Readings" 1912 Hymn 400.
